## Goal

What specific improvement does this pull request make?

## Baseline and change

How did the affected behaviour work before, and which files, modules and public
interfaces changed?

## Security and data

Which risks are reduced or introduced? Does this include a migration, existing
data impact, backup requirement or restore/downgrade procedure?

## Compatibility

Which existing endpoints, environment variables and workflows remain compatible?

## Validation

Which tests were added and run? List manual reviewer checks.

## Rollback and limitations

How can the change be safely reverted? What is deliberately not solved yet?
